action.provenance: A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN:

value: playground surfacing materials that contain more than 90 parts per million of lead
playground surfacing materials that contain fluorinated organic chemicals that contain at least 1 fully fluorinated carbon atom, including PFAS substances
playground surfacing materials that contain more than 20 milligrams per kilogram of PAH
